analyst_view.overall: Union Saint-Gilloise are 4th in the Europa League with 10 points and top of the Belgian league; they play this home game at Den Dreef in Leuven. Lech Poznan lead the Polish league but have only 1 point in Europe and need a win; they flew to Brussels on Wednesday with winger Sayyadmanesh back in full training and new keeper Karl-Johan Johnsson, but without Pablo Rodriguez (rehab in Spain), while captain Ishak is still training only on his own. Lech's other absentees (Walemark, Moutinho, Gholizadeh, Douglas, Pruchniewski) are in the numbers. For Union, coach David Hubert has Sylla and Kricfalusi back in training but misses Havenaar, Mac Allister and Biondic (all counted) and reserve keeper Chambaere. Spanish referee Jose Maria Sanchez Martinez's card record is already counted; nothing new points either way, so I keep the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals, 2.6 for Union, with Biondic's absence already taken off and Havenaar's added for Lech. Lech get Sayyadmanesh back but miss Pablo Rodriguez and Ishak, and their recent scoring already reflects playing without Ishak, so the news roughly cancels and I stay at about 3.4.

corners.text: The numbers expect 8.2 corners, already trimming Union for their low recent corner count (-7.4%). Lech are expected to set up cautiously in a 4-2-3-1 and are short of wide players with Walemark out, but their share is already small (3.1), so I stay at about 8.2.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards, adding about 19% for referee Sanchez Martinez's record and lowering for both sides' calm recent games. Lech need points but are a passing side rather than a rough one, Union play a controlled game, and a modest crowd at Den Dreef adds little heat, so I stay at about 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers expect 30.8 shots, with Union expected to dominate (21.4). Both clubs play league games three days later, but Lech's line-up has barely changed lately and Union get Sylla back, so the one-sided game the numbers assume still fits and I stay at about 31.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.7 shots on target, already adding for Union's accurate recent shooting (+11.1%). Lech's attack without Ishak and Pablo Rodriguez is what their recent games already show, and Sayyadmanesh, just back, is likelier to have limited minutes, so I stay at about 11.7.
